December 02, 2025 – Phil Agulnik Karen Holmes

The lifting of the 2-child limit in Universal Credit has raised more than its fair share of headlines since the Chancellor’s Budget announcement last week, but we’ve heard little of the impact this will have on claimants’ Council Tax Reduction entitlement.

November 03, 2025 – Phil Agulnik

Register for an entitledto account

It's free to register with entitledto but please note we have a fair use limit of 10 calculations per year on this site.

If you provide advice for others who are not friends/family and think you will need more than 10 calculations per year find out about the benefits of upgrading before registering. You will be able to upgrade when you reach your fair use limit but your previous calculations will not be transferred to your new account.
